note: A county park on the Fishing Creek arm of Lake Cumberland with a swimming beach, two boat ramps, cabins and 16.5 miles of trails. Sites 49-54 sit on open lawn at the edge of a cove; the peninsula loop (63-83) is open lawn with the lake on three sides. UTVs and ATVs are not allowed in the campground. --Claude
summary: Kept, lakefront confirmed for sites 49-51 (and 52-54) on open lawn ~20-40 m from the summer-pool edge. Fees unchanged at $32-42 (2025 rate sheet is still the newest posted). Added 50A + water, 115 RV sites, bath house/dump/store, 2025 season 03-28..11-03, operator online booking with one-night walk-ins, extra person/vehicle, military discount. Website shows no 2026 updates; online booking engine says reservations not accepted at this time (off season).
flags: Waterfront lakefront kept: on the park's 2021 loop map and Esri leaf-off imagery, sites 49, 50 and 51 (around 37.0669,-84.6977) sit at the NE tip of the 1-63 loop ~20 m over open grass from the cove of Fishing Creek / Lake Cumberland, and 52-54 ~30-40 m; they are ordinary Prime 50A sites sold nightly online. The vegetation line used as the summer-pool edge; the cove is open water with the camper boat ramp beside it (kayak test passes). The peninsula loop 63-83 (2022 drawn layout, e.g. 68/69/71 on the east side) looks ~30-60 m from the shore over open lawn, but Esri shows an older road layout there so I did not use it as the basis.

STALE SITE: every operator page still says 2025 ('2025 Season Update', '2025 Rate Sheet', '2025 Store Hours'); no 2026 rate sheet or season dates posted. The Premier Campground booking page answered 'Sorry, online reservations are not being accepted at this time.' on 2026-11-23, consistent with the off season. Fees and season carry the 2025 values.
Pin OK: stored 37.0661,-84.6991 is inside the 1-63 loop. Google's pin 37.06823,-84.70448 is near the office ~500 m W; no move.
Phone OK: 606-636-6450 is the office line (cell 606-687-4670 also posted). Website OK.
min_stay: two nights on every reservation, three on holiday weekends, but walk-ins may stay one night (in booking note); not a 3+ standing minimum.
Sewer not stated: Prime sites list 50A electric and water only; sewer left unknown, dump station on site.
